metadata.description: MCP connectors for Claude: PUC Minas Canvas, multi-account Gmail and personal WhatsApp (self-hosted).

plugins.name: canvas-puc
plugins.description: PUC Minas Canvas LMS in the cloud: due dates, assignments, grades, announcements, modules, files and discussions. Nothing is installed on your computer.

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.description: Multi-account Gmail in the cloud: read, search, send, reply, forward, drafts, labels, archive and trash, with confirmation before sending or deleting. Nothing is installed on your computer.

plugins.name: whatsapp
plugins.description: Personal WhatsApp (read and send with confirmation) through your own server on Cloudflare Workers + Containers. Requires deploying the template first (see the connector README).
